C254.notes: SER EU-VA-001. Photo confirmed · Joseph year correction 1951 (was misread 1962). Reverse standing Prudentia · CITTA' DEL VATICANO · 1951 · L. 10 · PRVDENTIA (Pius XII portrait obverse not shown). Aluminum virtue series under Pope Pius XII — Holy Year aftermath / early 1950s Vatican change weight while Italian lire still ruled Roman tills. Country #45 — first Vatican in the vault; Italy neighbors C011/C199/C211/C240 / EU-IT-. Sole Vatican · SER EU-VA-001. Vatican City flips now 1.
C254.story: A 1951 10 lire from Vatican City. The obverse shows Pius XII portrait; the reverse shows standing Prudentia; CITTA' DEL VATICANO, 1951, L. 10, PRVDENTIA. Struck in aluminum.

C305.notes: Reverse-only identification: CITTA' DEL VATICANO, the 1958 date, L.20 and CARITAS in the exergue were all read from the photo. The 1958 strike is the aluminium-bronze variety of the type (the 1957 strike is bronze); the alloy itself cannot be tested from a photo.
C305.story: A 1958 Vatican 20 lire showing Charity (Caritas) standing with children. It was struck in Rome for Pope Pius XII and only ever reached collectors inside the Vatican's yearly mint sets.
